description: Use before buying or holding a Solana token to see who really holds it: which top holders were funded from the same address, concentration after merging linked wallets, holder and liquidity dynamics from our snapshot history, blacklist proximity within two transfers, and the mint's authorities and Token-2022 extensions (transfer fee, hook, permanent delegate). Includes raw balances and supply as strings, explicit owner coverage and snapshot age. Returns a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, or unknown when data is missing) with reasons. If the RPC provider cannot list the holders, returns the available mint checks with explicit coverage and null holder sections; this partial result cannot be ok. Price: 0.030 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.
name: token_deep_check
title: Holder graph and history for a token
